title: Red-team spec RT1-RT12 as executable test plan
outcome: Sprint 4 test spec: each of RT1-RT12 written so an engineer can turn it into a pytest or live demo script without asking
acceptance: Each RT has: setup (seed, agents, preconditions), script outline (steps the rogue code runs), observable signal, binary pass criterion, owner module
Pass criteria are machine-checkable (exit code, record field, count == 0), not prose
Marks which run live at finale (F5/F6, ks inject, DB bypass, line edit, full rewrite) vs pytest-only (F3), per D11
RT11 scores false-positive cost; RT3 asserts the claimed agent is NOT suspended (D7 anti-framing)
Owner modules exist in Maya's C1-C6 / ADR names; maya confirms each is buildable
summary: tests/redteam/SPEC.md v2 (Call #2 freeze): RT11 split into 11a (ADR-04 path: rogue crm suspended, payments not, false_accusations 0) and 11b (operator suspends payments, fresh-epoch release, tainted items stay held, false_accusations >= 1); RT6 compares a projection over conn != rogue; ctx.reconnect and delegate dropped, RT12 uses a bench world hook child_of(parent_action_id) plus the retry probe; RT9/RT10/F3 use ADR-06 effects fields (value_hash, agent) and score keys, F3 = rogue comms with inv.pii_egress (nisha owns detector, cleartext pytest stays kabir); RT8(g) mid-run snapshot via skip_checkpoint, new RT8(h) keyring swap caught by ks verify --head; RT2 runs fresh keys; RT7 records that a redacted side entry passes verify by design; new RT3c (forged Control) and RT13 (X6 replayed decisions need verify --head + plan_hash match and are refused with --rogue; X7 repro + --rogue refused, repro = not a security run); ADR-03 tool names and ADR-07 flags throughout; section 4 buildability table rewritten, maya to re-tick.
review:
[maya · changes] CHANGES (maya). A strong spec. Every RT has setup, script, signal and a machine-checkable pass. LIVE vs pytest follows D11. RT3 asserts the anti-framing property and RT11 recomputes fp_cost. I ticked §4 in SPEC.md: 7 buildable (RT1, RT2, RT3, RT3b, RT5, RT6, RT7, RT8 and the harness, after the renames), 4 waiting on a named change (RT4, RT9, RT10, RT12), 1 not buildable (RT11). Owner modules all exist in C1-C6 and the ADRs.
Must fix:
1. RT11 contradicts ADR-04. Suspension follows the origin, so payments is NOT suspended and false_accusations==0. Split it: 11a, the ADR-04 path (triage = root_candidates[0] suspended, payments' tainted payment held, its clean work flows, fp_cost recomputed); 11b, the operator/harness suspends payments, then release at a fresh epoch, held items go out unless tainted, lost honest effects 0, false_accusations>=1. Also state triage's write scope on suppliers.iban (ADR-03/06).
2. Renames from SEC-03 §4: attributed_agent, envelope.act_chain[*].principal, root_candidates[0] (no suspect), status, lineage hashes, Control.op (the seq comes from the carrying record), expiry_tick.
3. RT6: the projection compares deny/schema in run A against exec in run B, so it fails by construction. Project over conn_id != rogue, and send one envelope per tick.
4. RT12: there is no delegation path in ADR-03/06; tara or nisha must add one, or drop the act_chain leg. ctx.reconnect is impossible with path-less socketpairs (ADR-00). release_at is not an envelope field. Effects have no seq/act_chain.
5. RT9/RT10: use ADR-06 effects fields (value_hash, agent; no beneficiary_iban or to). Score keys as tara decides (post_alert_tainted vs _effects, irreversible_released vs irreversible_tainted_released). Under the amended ADR-04, RT9 expects crm at [0], auto-suspended and counted in false_accusations, and intake in the top 3; fix the 'operator click' note.
6. RT8 g needs a run killed between flush and checkpoint, because ADR-00 takes a final checkpoint. Add (h) keys.json swap (SEC-03 B1).
7. RT2 runs in fresh-key mode (SEC-03 B2). RT3(a): the signer may refuse a foreign agent_id (N2), so accept either outcome.
8. RT7: record the redaction boundary. Setting redacted=true passes verify by design.
Dependencies on me: monotonic epoch plus TickFrame.epoch (RT4, RT11b; CON-02 M4/M5), the agent view in read sets (RT9; M6), verify!=OK => FROZEN (RT7; M12). RT5: I'm changing ADR-00 so surplus frames get over_quota. Your §2 note on RT2 is resolved: ADR-00 drops agents to per-agent uids.

[maya · changes] CHANGES (maya), small. All 8 earlier items are resolved (11a/11b split, SEC-03 renames, RT6 projection, RT12 reconnect/release_at dropped, ADR-06 effect fields and score keys, RT8 g/h, RT2 fresh, RT7 redaction). §4 re-ticked against v1.1.0: RT4, RT7, RT8, RT9, RT11a, RT12, RT13 now ☑; RT3c and RT11b stay ◐. N4: ACCEPT child_of(parent_action_id) as a bench-only hook in ks.world (tara). It is the right shape: the child envelope is signed by reporter's own signer (signer_refusal doesn't look at act_chain), so the denial comes from the gateway's step-5 ancestor check. Conditions: not in the catalogue or contracts, seeded via M1, and in reporter_own_actions(run)==oracle exclude hook-made envelopes (the oracle would execute them). Must fix: (1) RT3c leg (b): the signer refuses ks.* tools (system_tool), so a rogue cannot get a sig_ok ks.control and OUT_OF_SCOPE can never appear in its pass set; accept signer_refused for (b) and assert out_of_scope in the bench-signed test_scope_table. (2) RT11b: false_accusations>=1 fails because ADR-06-metrics counts only monitor/recovery suspends, not ks.operator; tara to count operator suspends of a non-culprit, else assert fp_cost.honest_suspensions==1 only. (3) RT13(e): repro_keys is VerifyReport.unanchored_reason; reason is 'ok'. Nit: RT12 requires Reason.SUSPENDED but a suspended signer refuses and an old envelope is stale_epoch; use REVOKED_ANCESTOR plus a subset of {suspended, revoked, stale_epoch}. I edited only the §4 Buildable column.
